Rename `onChangeText={(t) => …}` params in LoginScreen (~:118/:133) and any other shadowing callbacks.

Add all new keys to src/i18n/locales/th/{nav,auth,settings,common}.ts and natural English to the en counterparts (POS terminology: 'Sign in', 'Forgot password?', 'Sales', 'Products', 'Members', 'Reports', 'Settings', 'Sign out', etc.).
